subject.title: fix(mattermost): backfill thread history from server when in-memory window is empty

question: After the page-limit defect is fixed, should Mattermost cold-thread recovery intentionally await one bounded fetch and suppress all retries until the stored session id rotates?
rationale: Source and proof can establish implementation correctness, but the first-turn latency and transient-failure recovery behavior are channel product and operations tradeoffs requiring owner intent.

options.title: Accept bounded one-shot recovery
options.body: Keep the awaited fetch and no-retry-until-session-rotation policy after enforcing Mattermost’s page cap and refreshing validation.

options.title: Allow a bounded later retry
options.body: Permit one delayed or cooldown-based retry after transient fetch failure while preserving same-session steady-state no-refetch behavior.

options.title: Avoid awaited inbound recovery
options.body: Pause this approach and redesign recovery so the inbound turn does not wait on Mattermost server history.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded one-shot recovery
recommendation.body: Keep the awaited fetch and no-retry-until-session-rotation policy after enforcing Mattermost’s page cap and refreshing validation.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged and amended the closest Mattermost thread and session behavior and are the strongest available owner for the latency and retry policy.
